content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Selling digital beats and music online is an emerging market, particularly in countries where conventional payment methods are inaccessible. Many creators rely on platforms like Gumroad, which charge up to 10% on every sale, significantly cutting into profits. In contrast, using NOWPayments for crypto transactions incurs only a 0.5% fee. This difference can mean retaining hundreds of dollars each month, enabling creators to invest more in their craft and growth.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The foundational architecture for selling beats online involves a combination of free tools that create a seamless experience for both the seller and the buyer. By utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, combined with a backend logic provider like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the transaction process. Payment verification through NOWPayments allows for real-time crypto transactions with minimal fees. This stack not only ensures operational efficiency but also grants full ownership of your data and sales.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is tailored for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are limited or unavailable. If you are a music producer, beat maker, or any digital creator looking to monetize your work, this infrastructure gives you the autonomy to sell directly to your audience. You do not have to rely on third-party platforms that take significant cuts from your sales, allowing you to focus on your art and your business without financial barriers.
Retain more of your earnings by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this sovereign commerce stack include a hosting service, a backend for transaction processing, a payment processor, and a delivery system. By integrating GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your storefront, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, you create a complete sales ecosystem. You can store your orders in Supabase or Google Sheets and deliver products via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that your customers receive their purchases instantly and securely.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling beats with crypto payments, first set up your storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle transactions. Register with NOWPayments to enable crypto payments, and connect your order storage to Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, configure your file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can access all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline this deployment process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Automate your sales process with minimal overhead and full ownership.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
